units.source_text: 洞宽二十多米，呈压扁的椭圆形。

en.t: The hole was more than twenty meters wide and had the shape of a flattened oval.

units.source_text: 对面一侧看起来比较舒缓，而这一边几乎接近于垂直。

en.t: The far side looked somewhat gentler, while this side was almost vertical.

units.source_text: 洞口像厚厚的陶器边缘，描绘出平稳的曲线，蜷缩进他的脚下。

en.t: The mouth of the hole was like the thick rim of a piece of pottery, tracing a smooth curve as it curled in beneath his feet.

units.source_text: 他提心吊胆地往洞边放上一只脚，探头探脑向下张望。

en.t: Nervously, he placed one foot at the edge of the hole and craned forward to peer down.

units.source_text: 洞里的幽暗和周围的明亮形成鲜明的对照，洞里似乎已经日薄西山了。

en.t: The gloom inside the hole stood in sharp contrast to the brightness around it, as though evening had already fallen down there.
